findings.failure_condition: projectValue recursively drops every key named requestId, diagnostic, sourcePath and other metadata-like names, including keys inside genuine tool output. A product item with toolOutput {requestId:event-request-42,diagnostic:compiler diagnostic,sourcePath:src/main.rs} is emitted as toolOutput {}.
findings.required_behavior: Separate internal collection metadata from event payload by origin or schema, and preserve event/tool content keys and values in the authenticated history DTO.

findings.failure_condition: INLINE_IMAGE_DATA_URL matches only data:image/<type>;base64, so valid data:image/png;charset=utf-8;base64,AAAA and data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%3E remain in the product item payload instead of being omitted.
findings.required_behavior: Exclude supported image data URL forms from item and detail payloads, mark omitted media partial, and keep history envelopes bounded.

test_assessment.applicability: Applies to the current cumulative S3 Gateway checkpoint and changed persistent test; final Rust-to-product DB claims remain due in S4.
test_assessment.boundary: The product-history-read command covers provider projection and a WebSocket Gateway with an injected Store and mocked auth; it does not establish final real SQLite or Rust integration, which is due in S4. Existing Owner/IPC and Android commands cover their declared regressions.
test_assessment.necessity: Focused provider and Gateway behavior checks are needed for authenticated history, range and detail transport; existing IPC tests do not exercise the new projection.
test_assessment.oracle: Current assertions use fixed event paths and source metadata examples, but they do not independently cover ordinary event fields whose names collide with collection metadata or image data URLs with parameters or non-base64 encoding.
test_assessment.reason: The S3 provider and Gateway change modifies a persistent Node history test and reuses the IPC/Owner and Android regression gates.
test_assessment.reuse: Reuses the existing sync delta/ACK protocol, Owner/IPC tests and Android JVM suites. The new product-history-read tests cover S3 initial behavior but omit both observed failure conditions.
